The box at the top shows exactly what the car will display, at the screen's real proportions.

• Drag the picture with one finger to choose the visible part.
• Pinch with two fingers to zoom in and out — the Zoom slider follows your fingers.
• Rotate (top corner) turns the picture a quarter turn each tap.

A picture that does not cover the whole screen leaves space on both sides. The three buttons decide what goes there:
• Fill — enlarge the picture until it covers everything. No sides, but the top and bottom of the picture are cropped.
• Blur — a blurred copy of the picture itself on both sides.
• Solid colour — one colour on both sides, which you choose.

Fade edges softens the join between the picture and the sides.

Apply to all images gives every picture in the library these same settings. Reset returns this picture to automatic. Done saves and closes — everything is saved as you go, so nothing is lost either way.

The program owns the screen: it plays the wallpaper library — pictures, animated GIFs and videos — as a slideshow and draws the clock over it. It is the mode for any car that is not listed by name.

Exactly the Others mode (slideshow and clock), but the window is pinned to 1920×720 for the very wide Leopard (FSE) screens. With «Auto-start app when the car turns on» switched on, the program is also brought back to the front whenever the screen wakes up.

On screen it is the Others mode: the slideshow and the clock. In addition, Settings → Wallpapers has a «GWM Split» section that copies the pictures tagged GWM Split in the cloud into a folder on this car (Pictures/GWMSplit_Styles), which the GWM Split dashboard app reads.

On screen it is the Others mode: the slideshow and the clock. In addition, Settings → Wallpapers has a «Jetour images» section that copies the pictures tagged Jetour in the cloud into Pictures/G700 on this car, which the head unit\'s own gallery app reads.

The program draws nothing itself — it is a picker. You choose a picture or a video, it hands it to Android\'s wallpaper system and closes: no clock, no slideshow. Settings → Wallpapers also has a «TS Leo Dash images» section that copies the pictures and videos tagged Leopard into a folder for the TS Leo Dash instrument-screen app.
The same product as Leopard under its own name: the program is only a picker that hands the chosen picture or video to Android\'s wallpaper system and closes — no clock, no slideshow.

A picker for the Chery iCAR 03T. The car\'s launcher shows its own carousel of pictures, so the chosen picture is downloaded into the folder that launcher reads and added to its carousel. Pictures only — this car cannot take a video.

A picker for Lynk & Co (Flyme) screens. The chosen picture is handed to the car\'s own theme app, which opens its preview with an «Apply» button; a video is played through the program\'s own live wallpaper instead.

On the first open a download screen fetches the whole library first («Skip» lets it continue in the background). Then:
• Swipe left or right to change the wallpaper — a swipe also checks for new ones.
• Tap the screen once to hide the clock and the buttons (wallpaper only); tap again to bring them back.
• Long-press to move the picture: drag it to where you want it, then tap to save.
• The gear button opens Settings. A red dot on it means a newer version is available.
• With a remote or a knob: left/right change the wallpaper, the centre or menu key opens Settings.
The clock, date, Hijri date, weather and battery are drawn over the wallpaper as set in the Clock sections; «Automatically switch between images» and its interval are in Wallpapers.

This screen is the whole program: open, choose, close.
• Top bar: the mode chip, the gear (the only way into Settings in this mode) and this Help button.
• Left: «Available wallpapers» — the cloud library — with the two type filters above it.
• Middle: the library, two pictures across. Tap a picture to see it full screen with «Set as wallpaper» and «Change»; a video plays in its preview. «Current» marks the wallpaper that is set now.
• Right: «From the device» browses the head unit's own storage; «From a phone» receives a file over a QR code.
• Bottom: the Set button and a status line.
Pictures you added from the device or a phone carry a pencil (re-frame) and a bin (delete). Videos in the library are downloaded to the car one at a time before they can be previewed or set. After a successful set the program closes itself and returns to the home screen, where the new wallpaper is visible.

The two round buttons above the cloud library filter what is shown:
• Nothing lit — everything is shown.
• One lit — only that type (videos only, or images only).
• Both lit — everything again.
The filter is not saved: both start off every time the screen opens. It only changes what is drawn — nothing is downloaded or deleted because of it — and it applies to the cloud library only, not to the device or phone panes.

In Settings → Wallpapers → «Manage images», the same two round buttons sit above the grid: nothing lit shows everything, one lit shows only that type, both lit shows everything again. They only change what the list shows — hiding a picture is done with its tick box.

For a picture, «Set as wallpaper» first asks how it should fit the screen — «Crop to fill» or «Fit whole image» (not asked for a picture already framed in the editor). The car\'s own wallpaper preview then opens: press «Apply» on it to finish. A video is played through the program\'s own live wallpaper instead and goes through Android\'s wallpaper screen, as in Leopard.

The button reads «Download the wallpaper»: the picture is written into the folder the car\'s launcher reads and added to its carousel — swipe through the launcher\'s wallpapers to reach it. Pictures only; a video or GIF is refused with a message. The bin button in the top bar opens «Car wallpapers»: remove our picture from the car, or open the car\'s own wallpaper screen — the pictures the car came with can only be deleted there.

The library lives in the cloud and is managed by the store: pictures for all cars, plus pictures assigned privately to this car. To have one assigned, give the store the device code — Settings → Wallpapers shows the Device ID and «Show device QR Code».

The program checks for new wallpapers when it opens, every 5 minutes while the clock runs, and when you swipe; «Check for new wallpapers» in Settings forces a check. Videos are downloaded to the car before they play and pictures are cached, so the last synced library also works offline. «Manage images» lists everything the car has: untick a picture to hide it on this car only (nothing changes on other cars), then Save. The pencil on a cloud picture first copies it to this device and then opens the editor — the edit stays on this car.

This mode has no slideshow, so there is no 5-minute timer: the library is refreshed every time the picker opens, and again when you come back to it after a minute. Offline, the last synced library is shown. If the library is empty, «Check for new wallpapers» appears in its place. To hide a picture on this car only, use Settings → Wallpapers → «Manage images».

Settings → Wallpapers: «Also show images/video from the device folder» adds the files in the program\'s own folder (its path is shown underneath) to the slideshow, and «Add from this device» opens the file picker to copy pictures or videos into that folder. A single picture added this way opens in the editor when «Open the editor after every import» is on; a batch is added as is. Only pictures added from the device or a phone can be deleted, from «Manage images».

«From the device» opens the head unit\'s file picker. The chosen picture is copied into the program, opened in the editor so you can frame it for this screen, and then appears in the device pane with a pencil (re-frame) and a bin (delete). Files that arrived this way exist only on this car.
Sending a picture from a phone (QR code)

The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as this screen.
1 — Open the QR code (%1$s) and scan it with the phone's camera.
2 — A page opens on the phone: press its button and choose a picture, a video or a GIF.
3 — The upload starts by itself and the file appears here.
Leave the screen open until the phone has finished — closing it stops the upload. If the Wi-Fi changed, «Refresh code» makes a new code. A picture that arrives opens in the editor for framing.
the big button at the top of Settings → Wallpapers
the «From a phone» circle in the picker

The editor opens for pictures added from the device or a phone, and from the pencil on a picture. The box at the top shows exactly what the car will display:
• Drag with one finger to choose the visible part; pinch with two fingers to zoom; «Rotate» turns it a quarter turn.
• A picture that does not cover the screen leaves space on both sides — «Fill» crops instead, «Blur» fills the sides with a blurred copy, «Solid colour» with a colour you choose; «Fade edges» softens the join.
• «Apply to all images» gives every picture these settings, «Reset» returns to automatic, «Done» closes — everything is saved as you go.
The defaults for imported pictures (mode, blur strength, side colour, and whether the editor opens after every import) are under Settings → Wallpapers → «Image import settings». The editor has its own Help button too.
In this mode the framing is burnt into the copy that is handed to the car, so the car shows exactly what the editor showed.

Settings → Wallpapers → «%1$s» keeps a folder on this car in step with the cloud channel of the same name, for %2$s. It needs the «All files access» permission — grant it with the button in that section. The section shows the folder path, «Sync now», «Upload from phone (QR)» (the file goes straight into the folder) and a status line with the number of files. It also runs by itself: %3$s. Mirroring means the folder matches the cloud — a picture removed from the cloud is removed from the folder — but files sent from a phone or placed there by other means are never deleted. None of this affects the program\'s own wallpapers.
the head unit\'s own gallery app (Pictures/G700)

Header: the mode chip (tap it to change the mode), «Auto-save» (every change is saved the moment it is made — the back arrow applies it), and the language switch.
• General: auto-start when the car turns on, weather and city, settings text size, and the operating mode.
• Clock: the analog clock, the digital clock (24-hour format, Arabic numerals, seconds, date and Hijri date, colours and fonts, auto-contrast) and the clock layout (show over the wallpaper, position, size).
• Wallpapers: phone upload, Device ID / MAC and the QR code, enable the slideshow, automatic switching and its interval, «Manage images», «Check for new wallpapers», the device folder, «Add from this device», and the image import settings.
• Updates: see below.

Header: the mode chip (tap it to change the mode — choosing «Others» brings the clock and the in-app slideshow back), «Auto-save» (every change is saved the moment it is made), and the language switch.
• General: a banner explaining this mode, «Open the picker», auto-start when the car turns on, weather, settings text size, and the operating mode. The Clock sections are hidden — Android draws the screen, so they have nothing to act on.
• Wallpapers: phone upload, Device ID / MAC and the QR code, «Manage images», and the image import settings.
• Updates: see below.
«Lynk & Co interface size» in General enlarges or shrinks the whole picker for this screen.

Settings → Updates shows the version you are running and «Check for updates». No app store is needed: every time Settings is opened the program asks the store\'s server by itself and, if a newer version exists, shows an «Update available» dialog with what changed — «Update now» downloads it and opens the installer (the first time, Android may ask you to allow installs from this program). %1$s The mode-confirmation screen has a check-for-updates button as well. «Crash log» appears in Updates only on a car that has recorded a crash: it shows the last one, can send it to the store, and can be cleared.
On the wallpaper screen, a red dot on the gear button means an update is waiting — open Settings to install it.
In this mode there is no clock screen, so the check happens when you open Settings from the gear in the picker.
